note: Triennial election of the county council, 1927: nominations received by Thomas E. Reid, secretary, 26 April 1927; the only poll was in Portadown, 26 May 1927. No party labels are printed for the unopposed members in the nominations or the list of the new council, so none are given. Returned unopposed.
